biggest_catch: $250 requires $15,000 in cumulative qualifying direct deposits within 90 days of opening (at least 3 eligible direct deposits on different days); the $100 tier still requires $3,000. P2P/bank transfers/tax refunds do not count, former members are excluded forever, and payout lands only after the full 90-day bonus period plus up to 30 more days.
catches: $100 tier: cumulative eligible direct deposits of $3,000 to $14,999 during the 90-day Direct Deposit Bonus Period. $250 tier: cumulative total of $15,000 or more in the same period.
Each tier requires at least 3 eligible direct deposits made on different days during the 90-day period starting at checking account opening.

Eligible Direct Deposit = recurring payroll, pension, or government benefit payment via ACH. Excludes check deposits, peer-to-peer transfers (PayPal, Venmo, etc.), merchant transactions, bank-to-bank ACH transfers, wire transfers, and one-time deposits such as IRS tax refunds.

Not available to current or former members (individuals who have ever been a Member of the Credit Union are excluded), nor to referrals under other offers. One bonus per account per new member; cannot combine with any other New Member or Referral offer.

Must use a valid promo code at signup/account opening; must open a FIGFCU Checking account within 10 days of joining and remain a member for at least 90 days for the bonus to be paid; account must be in good standing.

Bonus is paid within 30 calendar days after the 90-day bonus period ends, posted to the Membership savings account (must have an active savings account at payout). FIGFCU may take up to 120 days total from opening to pay the bonus.
Eligibility for the bonus is in the Credit Union's sole discretion. Board, officers, employees, immediate family members, and household members are excluded.
Promotion available from October 1, 2025 until further notice; subject to change or termination at any time without prior notice.

steps: Join FIGFCU (field of membership required) using a valid promo code at signup/account opening.
Open a FIGFCU Checking account within 10 days of joining.
Set up recurring eligible direct deposits (payroll, pension, or government benefits via ACH) into the checking account; avoid P2P, bank ACH transfers, wires, and one-time deposits.
Accumulate at least $3,000 (for $100) or $15,000 (for $250) in cumulative eligible direct deposits via at least 3 direct deposits on different days during the 90-day bonus period.
Remain a member in good standing for at least 90 days with an active Membership savings account.
Bonus is posted to the Membership savings account within 30 calendar days after the bonus period ends.
timing: The Direct Deposit Bonus Period begins when the checking account is opened and ends 90 calendar days later. If eligible, the bonus is deposited within 30 calendar days after the bonus period ends. Offer available from 10/1/2025 until further notice; subject to change/termination without notice.
